## Machinery-first reminder

- [ ] Every new gate, review or human step is automatable in CI, or has an
      open-decisions entry marked `machinery-first-inappropriate`.

- [ ] Accepted ADR bodies remain intact; changed decisions use a new ADR.

This reminder is not an additional review-approval requirement.
